user.title: Set up a panel
user.description: Add a panel on your network, or install Panel Assistant on one plugged into this computer.

menu_options.add_panel: Add a panel on your network
menu_options.install_usb: Install using USB on this computer

menu_option_descriptions.add_panel: Enter the panel's address. Home Assistant connects it if Panel Assistant is running, or offers to install Panel Assistant if it isn't.
menu_option_descriptions.install_usb: Plug the panel into this computer, not into the Home Assistant server.

install_usb.title: Install using USB
install_usb.description: Plug the panel into this computer, not into the Home Assistant server. USB debugging must be on in the panel's developer options; the [model-specific panel access guide]({panel_access_url}) shows how.

add_panel.title: Add a panel
add_panel.description: Enter the panel's hostname or IP address. If Panel Assistant isn't installed yet, first turn on network ADB on port 5555 using the [model-specific panel access guide]({panel_access_url}). Root access is not required. If the panel does not answer, [help for reaching a panel]({panel_help_url}) has steps for each model and other ways to install.

add_known_panel.title: Add a panel
add_known_panel.description: Pick a panel Home Assistant already knows through another app, or enter the panel's hostname or IP address. Panels marked ✓ already answer on network ADB. If Panel Assistant isn't installed yet, first turn on network ADB on port 5555 using the [model-specific panel access guide]({panel_access_url}). Root access is not required. If the panel does not answer, [help for reaching a panel]({panel_help_url}) has steps for each model and other ways to install.

found_panel.title: Panel Assistant is installed but not connected
found_panel.description: The Panel Assistant app {version} is installed and set up at {address}, but it isn't connected to Home Assistant yet. Connect it to finish.

found_unconfigured.title: Finish setting up this panel
found_unconfigured.description: The Panel Assistant app {version} is installed at {address}, but its setup isn't finished and it isn't connected to Home Assistant yet. Home Assistant can open the panel's setup wizard and connect the panel as soon as setup is done.

menu_option_descriptions.connect_found: Connect the panel to Home Assistant without finishing its own setup first.

panel_setup.title: Finish the panel's setup
panel_setup.description: Complete the setup wizard in the window that opened. Home Assistant connects the panel as soon as its setup is done.

choose_version.title: Choose a version
choose_version.description: Choose the version to install on the panel at {address}. Test versions may contain bugs.

confirm_migration.title: Panel found through {source}
confirm_migration.description: Home Assistant knows **{name}** through {source} at {address}. Submit to check the panel and install Panel Assistant's app on it. {source} and its device stay as they are.

confirm_discovery.title: Confirm discovered panel
confirm_discovery.description: Home Assistant found a Panel Assistant installation at {address}. Submit to verify it is still the same panel and add it as {panel_name}. No panel settings will change.

authorize_adb.title: Allow Home Assistant on the panel
authorize_adb.description:
Look at the screen of the panel at {address}: tick **Always allow from this computer**, then tap **Allow**. Android may call Home Assistant a computer.

Select Submit to ask the panel again.

confirm_install_candidate.title: Install Panel Assistant {version}?
confirm_install_candidate.description:
Ready to install on the panel at {address}.

Your other apps are not touched.

confirm_install_rc.title: Install Panel Assistant {version}?
confirm_install_rc.description:
Testing only: Panel Assistant {version} is a release candidate, not a stable release, and may contain bugs.

Ready to install on the panel at {address}.

Your other apps are not touched.

release_preview_only.title: Release cannot be installed automatically
release_preview_only.description: Panel {address} is eligible for further inspection, and release {version} ({tag}, SHA-256 {sha256}) was authenticated. This release has no signed installation descriptor, so Home Assistant will not create an ADB credential, download the APK, or change the panel. Submit to choose another version.

install_result.title: Finish panel setup
install_result.description:
Panel Assistant {version} was installed at {address}.

Submit to retry only the final read-only identity and health checks. No installation step will be repeated.

After Home Assistant adds the device, follow the browser setup link in the Add dialog on a computer that can reach the panel on its local network. If prompted, approve ADB on the panel.

progress.authorize_adb:
Look at the screen of the panel at {address}: tick **Always allow from this computer**, then tap **Allow**. Android may call Home Assistant a computer.

This carries on by itself once the panel allows it.
progress.installing:
Installing Panel Assistant on {address}. Keep this dialog open; it finishes on its own.

If you close it, the install keeps running. Add the same address again to finish.

error.old_app_installed: This panel still runs the old ha-paneld app. Panel Assistant 1.0 cannot move it to the new app, and installs nothing beside it. Install Panel Assistant 0.9.0 first (in HACS open Panel Assistant, choose Redownload, and pick version 0.9.0), add the panel and move it with its Repair, then install 1.0.0.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to a valid Panel Assistant health endpoint.
error.invalid_address: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL scheme or path.
error.invalid_install_address: Enter only the panel hostname or IP address.
error.install_resolution_failed: Home Assistant could not resolve this panel address. Check the address and local DNS, then try again.
error.install_resolution_timeout: Local name resolution timed out before the panel address could be pinned safely. Check local DNS, then try again.
error.install_too_many_addresses: This hostname resolved to too many addresses to pin safely. Use a dedicated local hostname or private IP address.
error.unsafe_install_target: Installation is allowed only to a private local IPv4 address or a unique-local IPv6 address. No ADB connection was attempted.
error.install_target_changed: The hostname no longer resolves to the same pinned panel address. No ADB key or installation was sent. Check the address and start again.
error.adb_unreachable: The panel answered, but nothing answered on its Android Debug Bridge port (5555). On the panel, turn on Android Debug Bridge and allow it over the network, then try again. If you can plug the panel into the computer you are browsing on, install over USB instead.
error.panel_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check that the address is right and the panel is switched on and on your network, then try again. If you can plug the panel into the computer you are browsing on, install over USB instead.
error.adb_still_unauthorized: The panel has not accepted this Home Assistant instance yet, or did not remember it.
error.adb_credential_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist its ADB credential. No panel change was attempted. Check the Home Assistant storage and logs before retrying.
error.installed_without_health: The Panel Assistant package is installed but its health endpoint did not respond. This flow will not overwrite or repair it. Do not retry automatic installation; open Panel Assistant on the panel, or follow the steps at {recovery_address}. After restoring a healthy installation, start again to connect it.
error.retained_or_ambiguous: The panel may contain a retained Panel Assistant package record or its package state could not be proven absent. No panel change was made. Retry once if the connection was unstable; otherwise follow the steps at {recovery_address}. Do not uninstall or reset the app without a verified backup.
error.incompatible: The Panel Assistant package was not found, but the panel's Android SDK or processor architecture is not supported. No APK was downloaded or installed.
error.cannot_resolve_release: An install candidate was found, but Home Assistant could not resolve and verify the selected Panel Assistant release. No APK was downloaded or installed. Check internet access and, if testing a release candidate, that the exact tag is published with its signed assets. No other release will be substituted.
error.invalid_release_candidate: Choose a version from the list.
error.install_candidate_changed: The panel identity or clean package state changed after the preview. No installation job was created. Start again after checking the panel.
error.installed_artifact_mismatch: The installed app is not byte-identical to the release you chose, so Home Assistant did not overwrite it; choose its exact release, or follow the steps at {recovery_address}.
error.install_plan_rejected: The panel and signed release could not be bound into a safe installation plan. No installation job was created.
error.install_job_conflict: A different installation job already owns this panel identity. No second job was created.
error.install_receipt_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist the installation receipt. No new panel action was authorized.
error.install_finalization_busy: Another setup dialog is completing this panel. Wait for it to finish, then retry if needed.
error.install_finalization_retry: The installation completed, but a final read-only network, ADB, or health check is temporarily unavailable. Check the panel and retry; the installation will not run again.
error.release_catalog_unavailable: Home Assistant couldn't load the list of versions. Check its internet access, then submit to try again.
error.release_catalog_empty: No versions are published yet. Submit to check again.
error.release_selection_required: Choose a version from the list.

abort.old_app_installed: This panel still runs the old ha-paneld app. Panel Assistant 1.0 cannot move it to the new app, and installs nothing beside it. Install Panel Assistant 0.9.0 first (in HACS open Panel Assistant, choose Redownload, and pick version 0.9.0), add the panel and move it with its Repair, then install 1.0.0.
abort.reinstall_successful: The app was installed again. This panel keeps its Home Assistant history and settings.
abort.usb_installed: Panel Assistant is installed and the panel has been added to Home Assistant. Finish the panel's setup in the installer window.
abort.reinstall_identity_mismatch: The app is installed, but it could not be linked to the kept panel. Its Home Assistant history and settings have been kept. Check the panel in Home Assistant before trying again.
abort.not_panel: Not a panel Panel Assistant can install on.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered panel did not prove to be the same healthy Panel Assistant installation. No Home Assistant entry or panel setting was changed.
abort.install_cancelled: The installation was cancelled before an APK was installed. No Home Assistant entry was created. To try again, add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same panel address.
abort.install_cancelled_after_staging_cleanup: The installation was cancelled and the staged APK was removed before installation. No Home Assistant entry was created. To try again, add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same panel address.
abort.install_authorization_failed: Home Assistant could not safely load or validate its stored ADB credential. No APK was installed. Check Home Assistant's storage and logs, then add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same address to try again.
abort.install_preflight_rejected: The panel no longer proved to be a clean, compatible installation target. No APK was installed. Check the panel as described at [{recovery_address}]({recovery_url}), then start again with the same address.
abort.install_artifact_rejected: Home Assistant rejected the release download or staging operation before package installation. No APK was installed. Check Home Assistant's internet access, storage and logs, then start again with the same address.
abort.install_transport_failed: Home Assistant could not complete the pre-install connection, download or staging step. No APK was installed. Check the panel, network, Home Assistant internet access and logs, then start again with the same address.
abort.install_package_failed: Android definitively refused the APK and Home Assistant removed its staged file. No app or Home Assistant entry was created. Check the panel's compatibility and available storage before starting again.
abort.install_launch_failed: The APK is installed, but Home Assistant could not complete or verify the launch step. Do not retry automatic installation. Open Panel Assistant on the panel; if it does not start, follow the steps at [{recovery_address}]({recovery_url}).
abort.install_health_check_failed: The APK is installed, but Panel Assistant did not pass its health check. Do not retry automatic installation. Open Panel Assistant on the panel; if it does not start, follow the steps at [{recovery_address}]({recovery_url}).
abort.install_ambiguous_mutation: An ADB staging, installation or launch operation may have changed the panel. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app. Follow the steps at [{recovery_address}]({recovery_url}) to check the panel.
abort.install_verification_required: The panel changed, but Home Assistant could not verify the installed package or clean up its exact staged file. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app. Follow the steps at [{recovery_address}]({recovery_url}) to check the panel.
abort.install_failed: The installer stopped with an unrecognized result. No Home Assistant entry was created. Do not retry automatic installation until you have checked the panel as described at [{recovery_address}]({recovery_url}).
abort.install_worker_stopped: The installer stopped and will not replay this job in the current Home Assistant process. Restart Home Assistant, reopen setup, and enter the same panel address to resume or receive a recovery result. No entry was created.
abort.install_recovery_required: Home Assistant cannot prove that it is safe to continue automatically. No entry was created. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app until you have followed the steps at [{recovery_address}]({recovery_url}).
abort.install_receipt_error: Home Assistant could not safely read the durable installation receipt. No entry was created.
abort.unknown: The setup flow lost its pending panel state. Start setup again.

create_entry.another_home_assistant: This panel is signed in to another Home Assistant. It has been added here, but its settings and sign-in have not changed. To connect it here, change Home Assistant and sign in on the panel.

voice_announcement_disconnected.message: The panel disconnected during the announcement

panel_app_too_old.title: {panel} needs app {required_version}
panel_app_too_old.description:
Home Assistant cannot see or control {panel} because app {version} does not support this connection protocol.

To fix:
1. Open [Updates]({updates_url}) and install a compatible app update for {panel}, if offered.
2. Wait for the panel to reconnect.

old_app_needs_090.title: {panel} still runs the old app
old_app_needs_090.description:
Panel Assistant cannot install or update {panel} while it still runs the old ha-paneld app.

To fix:
1. Follow the [safe recovery steps]({recovery_url}) to finish the move with Panel Assistant 0.9.0.
2. If any panel already runs the 1.0 app, or you have no backup from before the upgrade, ask for help before changing versions.
3. Finish all moves in 0.9.0, then update the integration to 1.0.

mqtt_panel_needs_090.title: {panel} was never moved off MQTT
mqtt_panel_needs_090.description:
Panel Assistant cannot connect {panel} while its entities still use MQTT without splitting their history.

To fix:
1. Follow the [safe recovery steps]({recovery_url}) to finish the move with Panel Assistant 0.9.0.
2. If any panel already runs the 1.0 app, or you have no backup from before the upgrade, ask for help before changing versions.
3. Finish all moves in 0.9.0, then update the integration to 1.0.

commission_permissions.title: Check permissions on {panel}
commission_permissions.description:
Missing Android permissions prevent some features on {panel} from working.

To fix:
1. At the panel, follow the [Android permission guide]({permissions_url}): in Settings → Apps → Panel Assistant, allow camera, microphone and notifications where listed.
2. Under Special app access, allow Modify system settings and Display over other apps; under Accessibility, enable Panel Assistant.
3. Return here and select Submit to check again.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

error.permissions_missing: A permission is still missing. Complete the steps on the panel, then select Submit again.
error.permissions_unreadable: Home Assistant could not verify every required permission. Check that the panel is connected, then select Submit again.

abort.entry_removed:
This panel has been removed.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

set_up_proximity.title: Set up proximity on {panel}
set_up_proximity.description:
{panel} cannot wake on a wave until its proximity sensor is set up.

To fix:
1. Open [proximity setup]({configure_url}) and select Set up proximity on panel.
2. Stand in front of {panel} and follow its screen instructions (about a minute).
3. When calibration is saved, return here and select Submit.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

error.proximity_not_calibrated: The panel still reports that proximity is not set up. Finish setup on the panel, then submit again.
error.proximity_calibrating: Setup is still running on the panel. Finish it, then submit again.
error.proximity_unreadable: Home Assistant could not read the panel's proximity state. Check that the panel is connected, then submit again.

abort.entry_removed:
This panel has been removed.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

voice_microphone_silent.title: The voice assistant on {panel} is not listening.
voice_microphone_silent.description:
The voice assistant on {panel} is not listening because its microphone check recorded only silence.

To fix:
1. Open [voice settings]({configure_url}).
2. Turn Voice assistant off and on to check again.
3. If it still fails, try another [Audio source]({audio_source_url}).

voice_microphone_no_audio.title: The voice assistant on {panel} is not listening.
voice_microphone_no_audio.description:
The voice assistant on {panel} is not listening because its microphone check received no audio.

To fix:
1. Open [voice settings]({configure_url}).
2. Turn Voice assistant off and on to check again.
3. If it still fails, try another [Audio source]({audio_source_url}).

voice_microphone_no_audio_detail.title: The voice assistant on {panel} is not listening.
voice_microphone_no_audio_detail.description:
The voice assistant on {panel} is not listening because its microphone check received no audio ({detail}).

To fix:
1. Open [voice settings]({configure_url}).
2. Turn Voice assistant off and on to check again.
3. If it still fails, try another [Audio source]({audio_source_url}).

wake_word_kept.title: {panel} kept its own wake word {wake_word}.
wake_word_kept.description:
{panel} is using its own model for {wake_word} instead of the shared model.

To fix:
1. [Open wake words]({configure_url}).
2. If you want the shared model, import its .json manifest and .tflite file; importing here replaces the shared copy and can update other panels.

wake_word_refused.title: {panel} could not install the wake word {wake_word}.
wake_word_refused.description:
{panel} could not add the shared wake word {wake_word}: {reason}.

To fix:
1. [Open wake words]({configure_url}).
2. Correct the reported problem, then import a compatible microWakeWord .json manifest and .tflite model; importing here replaces the shared copy and can update other panels.

volume_number_removed.title: {panel} no longer has a separate volume number
volume_number_removed.description:
Automations or scripts using {entity} can no longer set the volume on {panel}.

To fix:
1. Open [Automations]({automations_url}) or [Scripts]({scripts_url}) and find: {users}.
2. Replace volume-setting actions for {entity} with `media_player.volume_set` on this panel’s media player, using `volume_level` from 0 to 1 (0.5 is 50%).
3. Save your changes, then ignore this Repair.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Panel Assistant

confirm_restart.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm_restart.description:
Home Assistant is still running Panel Assistant {loaded}, so installed build {installed} is not active yet.

To fix:
1. Review [Panel Assistant]({integration_url}) if needed, then return here.
2. Select Submit to restart Home Assistant now.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

panel_user_mismatch.title: Confirm the Home Assistant user for {panel}

confirm_bind.title: Confirm the panel's user
confirm_bind.description:
{panel} cannot connect as {user} until you confirm this account.

To fix:
1. [Check the panel’s sign-in]({configure_url}).
2. Select Submit only if you set up {user} for this panel; it should then reconnect.
3. If you do not recognise the request, close this dialog and ignore the issue: anyone signed in can request a panel connection.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

confirm_rebind.title: Change the panel's user
confirm_rebind.description:
{user} asked to connect as {panel}, which currently accepts {bound_user}.

To fix:
1. [Check the panel’s sign-in]({configure_url}).
2. Select Submit only if you changed its account to {user}; this stops accepting {bound_user}.
3. Otherwise close this dialog and ignore the issue: this may be a takeover attempt.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

abort.entry_removed:
This panel is no longer set up in Home Assistant.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})
abort.user_unavailable:
The requesting user no longer exists or is deactivated; nothing was changed.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

no_update_route.title: {panel} cannot receive app updates
no_update_route.description:
{panel} cannot receive app updates, although its other features keep working.

To fix:
1. Follow the [update recovery steps for this panel]({recovery_url}).
2. Restore debugging access, or reconnect by USB if the steps require it.
3. Return to Home Assistant Updates when this Repair clears.

merged_panel_identity.title: Separate the merged panels: {panels}
merged_panel_identity.description:
{panels} share one device identity, so their native connections are refused and no entities are moved.

To fix:
1. [Open Panel Assistant devices]({integration_url}).
2. Update the app on every affected panel so each has its own identity.
3. Then delete the merged device and let the panels register again.

init.title: Resolve panel error
init.description:
The install or update did not finish.

To fix:
1. Follow the [recovery steps]({repair_url}).
2. Select **Support report** to check the cause, then **Try again** when it is resolved.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

support_report.title: Support report
support_report.description:
This report contains the saved details of the failed installation or update.

To fix:
1. Read [how to use this support report]({guide_url}).
2. Review the report for private information, then copy it into a [new Panel Assistant integration issue]({issue_url}).

{report}

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

clear_error.title: Clear error
clear_error.description:
Clearing this error deletes its saved report without changing the panel.

To fix:
1. [Save a support report]({guide_url}) first if you need it.
2. Select **Submit** to remove this error and report.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

retry_error.title: Retry could not finish
retry_error.description:
Retry could not finish, so this error and its report remain in Repairs.

To fix:
1. Follow the [recovery steps]({repair_url}).
2. Select **Submit**, then **Support report** to check the cause before retrying.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

progress.retrying:
Checking the panel and retrying safely.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

retry_error.title: Retry could not finish
retry_error.description:
Retry could not finish, so this error and its report remain in Repairs.

To fix:
1. Follow the [recovery steps]({repair_url}).
2. Select **Submit**, then **Support report** to check the cause before retrying.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

authorize_adb.title: Allow updates on {panel}
authorize_adb.description:
Home Assistant needs Android approval before it can update {panel}.

To fix:
1. Read the [ADB approval steps]({approval_url}).
2. Select **Submit**, then on {panel} tick **Always allow from this computer** and tap **Allow**.
3. After approval, select **Try again** from this Repair to retry the update.

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

[Learn more]({learn_more_url})

another_home_assistant.title: {panel} is signed in to another Home Assistant
another_home_assistant.description:
{panel} is added here but remains signed in to another Home Assistant.

To fix:
1. [Open the panel’s Home Assistant connection]({configure_url}).
2. If you intend to connect here, enter this Home Assistant’s address and save.
3. Reconnect and sign in with the account you want the panel to use; otherwise, keep its current server and ignore this Repair.

menu_option_descriptions.remove_app: Gives the home screen back to the panel's own launcher, then uninstalls the app.

onboarding.title: Finish setting up this panel
onboarding.description: Open the [panel's setup page]({setup_url}) from a device on the same network as the panel; it opens in a new tab. Finish the steps there, then come back and select Done.

authorize_adb.description: Select Submit, then look at the screen of {panel}: tick **Always allow from this computer**, then tap **Allow**. Android may call Home Assistant a computer.

updates.title: Panel updates
updates.description: Choose which panel app builds this panel may receive. Every build must be compatible with the running Panel Assistant.

data_description.prerelease_panel_builds: A prerelease Panel Assistant already allows prerelease panel builds.

remove_app.title: Remove Panel Assistant from {panel}
remove_app.description:
Panel Assistant first gives the panel's home screen back to its own launcher and turns the vendor apps it switched off back on, then uninstalls itself. Its settings on the panel are deleted.

On some panels and firmware versions, removing it leaves no way back to Android Settings or network debugging, so the app could not be installed again without opening the panel. Read [what removal can do to this panel]({risks_url}) before you select Submit.

data.delete_entry: Also delete this panel from Home Assistant

data_description.delete_entry: Leave this off to keep its entities and history for when you install Panel Assistant again.
